snippet.title: Chunky JUMP! × Indigo Park – Trailer
snippet.description:
😺WISHLIST CHUNKY JUMP! ON STEAM😺
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606780/Chunky_JUMP/

📢JOIN THE COMMUNITY 📢 (please read rules before joining)
https://discord.gg/thebunnygraveyard

Indigo Park joins Chunky JUMP! Play as Rambley, Mollie, Lloyd, Salem or Finley in these brand-new Indigo Park-insipired levels, exclusive to the Endless Mode. Massive thanks to @UniqueGeese and his team for trusting us with their wonderful world and characters. The Endless Mode roster just keeps growing and growing! I wonder, who will be Chunky and Vicky's next rivals?

What is Chunky JUMP?

A new short horror adventure in the world of The Bunny Graveyard—perfect for new and returning players! Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

#indiegames #chunkyjump #indigopark #pixelart #indiehorror #crossover
